description: This Java class implements an event handling strategy for handling AttributesDeleted events in the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class extends an abstract strategy and overrides a method to remove all attributes from a ThingBuilder when an AttributesDeleted event occurs.

classes.name: AttributesDeletedStrategy
classes.description: An Immutable final class that extends AbstractThingEventStrategy to handle AttributesDeleted events by removing all attributes from the associated ThingBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to handle AttributesDeleted events by removing all attributes from the provided ThingBuilder.
